title: Easy Delicious Crockpot Turkey Breast
description: Make this easy crockpot turkey breast with cranberry sauce, apple cider, and savory seasonings for a juicy turkey dinner with homemade gravy.

items: 1 3– pound boneless turkey breast, such as Butterball, with gravy packet
Remove gravy packet from turkey package and set aside. Leave netting around turkey while cooking.
Season turkey all over with salt, poultry seasoning, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder. Place seasoned turkey in a slow cooker.
Top with onion soup mix, then cranberry sauce. Pour cider around turkey.

Cook on Low for 5 to 6 hours or High for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the meat should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Transfer turkey to a cutting board, carefully remove netting with kitchen shears, and let rest while preparing the gravy.
Strain liquid from the slow cooker into a small saucepan; stir in reserved gravy packet and bring to a simmer.
Whisk 3 tablespoons cold water and 1 tablespoon cornstarch together in a small bowl until cornstarch is dissolved. Whisk into gravy and simmer until thickened.
Slice turkey and serve with gravy.
